title: Prove sharp dimension growth for column-capped Euclidean resolvents (no κ)
body:
For matrices with absolute row cap rho and column cap m*rho, column-budget control has a different Euclidean critical boundary than the induced 1-norm results in #6788/#6806. This isolated package proves the sharp dimension-growth order of the worst ||(I-E)^-1||_2 for integer m>=2 and fixed 0<rho<1:

- rho*sqrt(m)<1: limit exactly 1/(1-rho*sqrt(m)).
- rho*sqrt(m)=1: Theta(log n).
- rho*sqrt(m)>1: Theta(n^(log_m(rho*sqrt(m)))).

A finite Neumann-series upper bound covers arbitrary complex matrices. Nilpotent, zero-diagonal m-ary trees give all lower bounds. The critical lower bound uses coherent input across levels; a single inverse column would miss the logarithmic order. Exact finite-dimensional maxima are unclaimed.

Only six new files under `research/column-cap-spectral-growth/` are added. The original `uniform-transfer-audit` card is retained with explicitly changed/partial scope, an abstract conditioning side result. Its actual-caller acceptance gate remains unmet. No emitted Gaussian matrix, physical precision bill, supplier, selected assumption or new kappa is admitted. No selected or predecessor frozen files change.

Validation at head `867ecd59bce6e6a3ae0e894e5aa4f4d0d66e55dd`, Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.9, standard library only:

- Registered warning-strict normal and optimized replays pass with identical counts: 15 dense trees, 960 capped real matrices, 12 complex-phase realifications, 63 virtual radial cases through height 64, six controls. Dense inverses are checked in both multiplication orders, against path formulas, and with rational positive-semidefinite Euclidean upper certificates.
- Metadata/pins, exact committed bytes, executable modes and declared source history pass. Official export integrity and both declared inputs pass. Both direct modes from the final read-only Git-free export with empty PATH/PYTHONPATH pass with matching receipts; all nine exported files including the manifest remain unchanged.
- `git diff --check` passes. Selected baseline source bindings passed; no selected cold replay, native suite, predecessor scientific suite, Lean or Docker run. Hosted checks and independent scientific review are not claimed.
